mainEntity.name: Should I repair or replace my existing siding during exterior restoration?

acceptedAnswer.text: Deciding whether to repair or replace siding depends on the extent of the damage, the age of the existing material, and your long-term goals for the property. Minor, localized damage can often be repaired effectively, while widespread rot or extensive cracking might warrant full replacement for a more durable and aesthetically consistent result. Evaluating the cost-effectiveness and lifespan benefits of each option is a key decision factor.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repairing is suitable for minor damage, but extensive rot or cracking may require full siding replacement. Consider damage extent, age of material, and long-term goals.
